# experiment 3 phase 2 corrected rerun (generated by experiments/exp2/exp2_corrected.py)

**사후 수정 재실행:** 2018~2019년 데이터를 세 번째로 쓴 분석이라 확인적 증거가 아닙니다. 원래 사전 등록 실험 2의 판정(미달)은 그대로 유효합니다.

Trained on 8127 rows / 1689 papers (<= 2017); evaluated 6359 rows / 1201 papers (2018-2019). Candidates on original data: 146 (45 new). R=1000; raw bootstrap_exp2_corrected_20261005_190824.csv; chosen settings {'lgbm_full': {'num_leaves': 15, 'n_estimators': 300, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'impute': False}, 'lgbm_proc': {'num_leaves': 15, 'n_estimators': 300, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'impute': False}, 'ridge_full': 10, 'ridge_proc': 10}. Cells: original-data point [2.5%, 97.5%] of the resamples. Main candidates are re-derived in every resample (as in the original runs); *_fixed = candidates fixed to the original data (sensitivity); *_new = combinations absent from <= 2017 (skipped in 0 resamples with < 10); auc_high = device-level PCE >= 15% discrimination on pinned inputs.
